decisions.reason: The manual laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's core laser marking know-how, but it has only ever been mentioned on the website and the newer LC400 cabin may take its place, so the drop risk is moderate.

Thermal inkjet coding is the firm's established core competence, and the product has kept a dedicated page in both years, which signals stable commercial value the firm can readily interpret and improve.
Piezo inkjet extends the firm's deep inkjet knowledge base, and its continued dedicated page suggests the firm is successfully assimilating the technology into its portfolio.
Industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page, which marks them as a strategic line resting on accumulated laser expertise.
The newly launched LC400 cabin has its own page and builds on the firm's laser systems, so the firm can learn from early market feedback and refine it.

The lubricant printing system applies the firm's high-resolution inkjet knowledge to a new sheet-metal application, and its Blechexpo award validates its value even though web presence is so far limited.
